name: Userlike
description: Userlike is a customer-messaging platform for website chat, mobile messaging channels, conversations, contacts, operators, chatbots, routing, analytics, and support workflows.
agentUseSummary: Enter one customer-owned Userlike organization token, then let selected agents use content-free conversation operations or approved documented JSON API v3 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: USERLIKE_ORGANIZATION_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Userlike organization authentication token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated organization token and, where appropriate, run requests in a least-privileged dedicated operator context.

capabilities.label: Read conversation operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded conversation operational metadata without messages, notes, contacts, names, emails, phones, topics, ratings, surveys, navigation, custom fields, or raw records.

capabilities.label: Userlike JSON API v3
capabilities.description: Use documented fixed-origin JSON API v3 paths and methods allowed by the connected organization token.

approvalRequired.label: List conversation metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free Userlike conversation summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read conversation metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Userlike conversation through Relay's content-free projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use JSON API v3
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Userlike JSON API v3 operation authorized by the organization token; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free conversation reads and every broader JSON API operation require approval; fixed origin/version, secret isolation, token permissions, bounds, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected token-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin/version, secret isolation, bounds, audits, and Userlike limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted organization token only to the fixed Userlike JSON API v3 origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted organization token only to the fixed Userlike JSON API v3 origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Userlike organization token with appropriate organization/operator permissions is required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated organization token and least-privileged API operator where appropriate, enter the token in Relay, and verify bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader operations, rate limits, token rotation, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Userlike's official JSON API documentation defines the fixed api.userlike.com/api/um/v3 origin, authorization token header, organization token model, optional operator context, conversation list/single endpoints, pagination, mutations, and daily/burst limits.
